spots.text: RETURNED CHAIRS. Please do not sit.

secrets.name: Where the Chairs Went
secrets.text: Behind the black door are all the other chairs, hundreds of them, heaped to the ceiling. One stands upright in the middle, facing the door, as if it had been waiting for you to find it.

meta.label: The Chair
meta.blurb: There is one chair, and one lamp, and a great deal of dark. The chair is facing away from you. There is a book on it.
